components: 32 exact formulas replaying v2.4 stage experience including 44:47 failure/recovery

instinctive_modes.COLD_JUXTAPOSE_FULL: unknown geometry -> exact clone coverage of all root pivots
instinctive_modes.WARM_JUXTAPOSE_HYBRID: partial diversified parallel coverage; widen on failure
instinctive_modes.HOT_PREDICTIVE: learned ordering with sequential exact checks
instinctive_modes.fallback: HOT -> WARM -> COLD whenever prediction authority falls

learning_to_cover_signal.claim: Observed same-geometry fresh-retry coverage compression after pit-stop learning; not claimed monotonic or universal.

hard_250x250.interpretation: Parallel coverage drastically lowers ideal latency but spends more total compute; the recorded 2168 score is not an intelligence multiplier.

diagnostic.name: COVERAGE_LATENCY_REFERENCE_INFLATION
diagnostic.meaning: Mode changes make raw latency performance scores non-comparable as a recovery reference because broad parallel coverage can spike latency score while increasing total compute.
diagnostic.next_controller_requirement: dual latency/compute accounting with mode-normalized or Pareto recovery criterion
